children: Sterling rises slightly while gilt yields trim an earlier rise after U.K. Treasury Chief John Healey pledged government plans to drive economic growth. Healey delivered his first speech as the Treasury Chief at a manufacturing facility in Coventry on Monday. Healey said that delivering economic growth was the first priority of this government. He also announced a 150 million pounds fund from the British Business Bank for fast-growing firms in the North of England. Sterling rises 0.1% to $1.3534. The euro weakens by 0.1% to 0.8583 pounds. Ten-year gilt yields trade steady on the day at 5.140%, having traded up more than 2 basis points in early trade. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
